cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: Unwanted symbol in project version metadata dialogue
cases.description: Project about dialogue has a weird symbol ahead of its info in the metadata. ### To Reproduce Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Create a project 2. Then, click on it's about tab 3. Finally, see the bug ### Current Results The weird symbol `$1` appears ahead of it ### Expected Behavior No unwanted characters should be present ### Screenshots

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix: add additional version translation

Signed-off-by: Kush Trivedi <kushthedude@gmail.com>
